takes.line: d|tom|TNB said he'd be home. Spring Street loft. He's never home.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [dry, mild] TNB said he'd be home. Spring Street loft.

takes.line: d|tom|All yours. I like that. We'll look, together. One quick stop first. My starter has been alone for a week.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [quickly, soft, pleased] All yours. I like that. [quickly, calm, steady] We'll look, together. [quickly, dry, sheepish] One quick stop first. My starter has been alone for a week.

takes.line: d|tom|Mad? I'm proud. And a little mad.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [dry, mock-offended] I'm proud. [deadpan, grudging] As long as you didn't spin it on your pottery wheel.

takes.line: d|tom|That's not a Mr. Washington sentence. Let's check on the boulevard. Miss Odette and Doña Carmen.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [quickly, dry, unsettled] That's not a Mr. Washington sentence. [brisk, resolved] Let's check on the boulevard. [quickly, calm, steady] Miss Odette and Doña Carmen.

takes.line: d|tom|The smog wants everything to stay exactly the same. Forever. That's not a nice afternoon. That's a hostage situation.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [quickly, dry, grim] The smog wants everything to stay exactly the same. Forever. [quickly, flat, deadpan] That's not a nice afternoon. [cold, dry] That's a hostage situation.

takes.line: d|tom|Then that's where we're going. Nara, stay close.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [calm, resolved] Then that's where we're going. [quickly, gentle, soft] Nara, stay close.

takes.line: d|tom|Somebody plugged those pipes on purpose. Smog doesn't do that by itself.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [quickly, dry, uneasy] Somebody plugged those pipes on purpose. [low, suspicious] Smog doesn't do that by itself.

takes.line: b|deedee|Hold still! You've got a smudge!
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [grounded and natural; warm and loving when the line calls for it, firm and commanding when it calls for that, brisk, fond] Hold still! [fussing, firm] You've got a smudge!

takes.line: b|deedee|Ten thousand steps! Keep up, honey!
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [grounded and natural; warm and loving when the line calls for it, firm and commanding when it calls for that, upbeat, energetic] Ten thousand steps! [brisk, fond] Keep up, honey!
